facts.text: I can't imagine how life was before the invention of the airplane.
I think traveling long distances must have been so difficult before the invention of the airplane.
I think the invention of the airplane has brought the world closer together.
I think we can travel anywhere in the world within a matter of hours.
I think the technology of air travel has advanced over the years.
I think the planes we have now are so different from the ones the Wright Brothers invented.
I think the Wright Brothers' invention kickstarted the entire aviation industry.
I can't even imagine what the future of air travel holds.
I wonder whether flying cars or supersonic planes might be part of the future of air travel.
I can't wait to see how air travel will change in the future.
I think it is amazing to think about possibilities for future travel, like traveling to outer space one day.
I think air travel has impacted the environment.
I want to know whether sustainable solutions are being developed to reduce the carbon footprint of air travel.
